'''Coconut's Eevee''' (Japanese: '''ココナッツのイーブイ''' ''Coconut's Eievui'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} belonging to [[Coconut]] in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==History==
{{sectionstub}}

==Personality and characteristics==
Eevee is quite intelligent for Pokémon standards, being about as smart as the average child in kindergarten.

Eevee amazes {{MPJ|Clefairy}} and {{MPJ|Pikachu}} because he knows basic math. Eevee is very loyal to Coconut and stays close to her. When Coconut's experiments go wrong, he often bears the consequences. 

He meets [[Lu]], a female Eevee, and falls in love with her. They go out on dates and become a couple, much to the jealousy of the other male Pokémon.
